root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic orientations: remaining or being left as a residue, and dust or a dust-like colour.
root_idea.development: The remaining branch extends to continuance, remnants, what is left of milk, disease, night, or a people, and to people left behind. The dust branch extends to dust, dusty colour, earth, and related figurative uses; striving or hastening is treated as a divergent lexical development.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular active-participle citation form غَابِرٌ.
Displayed as the attested noun غَبَرَةٌ, meaning dust or a dusty coating.

senses.definition: Remaining behind; surviving or being left as a remnant after others depart or after an event has passed.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic غَابِرِينَ is a plural active participle used of people who stay behind, including those who remain when others leave or remain after the onset or continuation of punishment. The contexts support the sense of remaining or being left behind, rather than independently establishing the opposite sense, “past.”

senses.definition: Dust or a dusty coating clinging to a surface; dustiness.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence the noun describes dust covering faces. The sense concerns dust or the resulting dusty condition, not the separately vocalized noun غُبْرَةٌ for a dust-colour.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, last, or continue; of a person, to tarry, stay, or wait.
To pass away, go away, or depart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contrary lexical use to “remain,” explicitly reported as an occasional usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be future.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical or lexicographical use reported for this verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a wound, to become corrupt, heal over corruption, and recrudesce, or to remain continually recurrent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression describes a wound whose apparent healing is followed by renewed inflammation or discharge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bear or conceal rancour, malice, or violent hatred.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use said of a person and his concealed disposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The drawing up or withdrawal of milk from an udder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-verb verbal-noun use concerning milk becoming held back in the udder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To soil or sprinkle a person or thing with dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II construction with a direct object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A devotional recitation in which the voice is trilled, reiterated, or prolonged, including recitation of poetry, praise, or Quranic verses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is used for a chanting or vocally reiterated form of devotional performance; the cited discussion preserves a historical disagreement about its religious status.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give a guest dates of the kind called غُبْرَان.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized hospitality construction with a guest as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an idiom, to oppose or resist and then acquiesce for the sake of obstinate disputation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Restricted to the cited expression concerning argumentative opposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The literal intransitive Form IV use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To outstrip, get before, or go ahead of someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression derived from raising dust in another’s face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strive, work vigorously, hasten, or apply oneself diligently in seeking something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction presenting eagerness and speed as raising dust.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set about or commence doing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the sky, to rain vehemently upon people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An impersonal or intransitive weather construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To milk a camel, drawing out what remains in her udder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V construction focused on extracting the remainder of milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an idiom, to marry or seek offspring from the young or old in order to increase progeny.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning is preserved from the cited saying about taking the first seed of the young and the remainder of the old.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To obtain offspring from a woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction explicitly illustrated with a woman advanced in age; that illustration does not impose a general restriction on the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become sullied or sprinkled with dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also said of dates or dried dates that become dusty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become dust-coloured or assume a colour like dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related intensive Form IX use also applies to a day that becomes very dusty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A remainder, remnant, residue, or relic of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of what remains of milk, menstrual blood, disease, the night, or a people; the core meaning is what is left after a larger quantity or phase has passed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rancour, malevolence, malice, concealed enmity, or violent hatred.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for hostile feeling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Remaining, lasting, or continuance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting persistence or what continues.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The future.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A usage attributed to some grammarians.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disease affecting the interior of a camel’s foot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-health term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A morbid affection of a vein that is difficult or impossible to cure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical medical or veterinary specialization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity, misfortune, trial, or affliction from which there is little or no escape.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom for a persistent or exceptionally serious hardship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who opposes another, then returns or gives regard to the other’s words.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate idiomatic interpretation of the same expression, associated with disputation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A serpent dwelling near a small, stagnant body of water and not readily approached.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized epithet preserved in a poetic description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water that is small in quantity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dust or earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal synonym of تراب in the cited lexical entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wound in a corrupt state, or one that heals over corruption and then becomes recurrent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival construction describing recrudescent injury.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vein that repeatedly becomes inflamed or discharges.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical expression for a constantly recurrent condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that remains or lags behind the other camels when driven.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed descriptive collocation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind or species of fish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act or condition of dirtying or sprinkling something with dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the vocalized noun غَبْرَةٌ, distinct from the Quranic غَبَرَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dust-colour or dusty hue, including a dusty complexion produced by grief or anxiety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for colour or complexion, distinct from the Quranic dust noun غَبَرَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cluster of two or more dates growing on one base.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources differ on whether the dates are ripe, unripe, or small and green.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small dust-coloured passerine bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological noun; the entry also records a variant or suspected mistranscription in related material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dust, especially dust raised and spreading, or what remains of such dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The entry also records a closely related use for dust in motion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The moving to and fro of dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized distinction within the noun غُبَارٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overtake or catch up with someone, literally to cleave his dust; in the negative, to fail to overtake him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom of pursuit and speed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be clear, perspicuous, or free from obscurity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom meaning that no dust or obscurity lies upon a statement or matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind or variety of dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A known plant or tree of the plains, or its fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources identify it variously with the service-tree or sorb and related plants; the name is connected with the colour of its leaves or fruit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An intoxicating beverage made from millet or from the fruit of the plant called غُبَيْرَاءُ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical beverage term, also called غُبَيْرَاءُ السَّكَرِ when distinguished from a date-based preparation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Passing, going away, or past.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contrary use to “remaining,” reported as occasional or lexicographical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Future time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical use attributed to some lexicographers; it is not the Quranic sense of the plural form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lasting or everlasting state of existence; the afterlife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine nominal expression for the latter or enduring state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dust-coloured or of a colour like dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The masculine adjective has غَبْرَاءُ as its feminine and غُبْرٌ as its plural.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The wolf.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional epithet attributed to the animal’s dusty colour.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The female of the partridge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional zoological use of the feminine form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The earth or ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation based on its dusty colour or the dust upon it, contrasted with the sky or heaven.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come on foot, literally upon the bare earth or ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed expression involving غَبْرَاءُ الظَّهْرِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To return disappointed or without attaining what one sought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A variant interpretation of the expression, emphasizing failure to accomplish the desired object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave someone possessing nothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom for prevailing over someone in an altercation and stripping him of what was in his hands.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The poor, needy, or indigent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is explained as referring to people cleaving to the dust.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strangers, or people whose family or tribal affiliation is unknown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: One of several explanations of the expression in the cited poetic context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People who gather to drink without being mutually acquainted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A context-specific social use reported as an alternative interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People who contribute equally to expenses incurred on a journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A context-specific interpretation of the same expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thief or robber.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed expression with the feminine form غَبْرَاءَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land abounding in coverts or trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical description of wooded or sheltered terrain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Herbage growing in plain or soft land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare botanical or landscape use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of plant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The entry suggests that the plant may be the one otherwise called غُبَيْرَاءُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A footprint that is becoming obliterated or effaced; alternatively, one that is recent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed descriptive expression preserving two reported interpretations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Might or power that is departing and becoming effaced.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A year of drought in which there is no rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is explained by the dustiness of the horizons and ground resulting from lack of rain and herbage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Severe hunger or famine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed descriptive expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel whose foot interior is in a withering condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-health adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group devoted to praising or glorifying God through reiterated vocal recitation, including Quranic recitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional collective noun; the source gives a historical explanation connecting the name with the lasting state of existence and records a disputed religious evaluation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree that becomes overspread with dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that produces abundant milk after other camels that have recently given birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal and milk-production term.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The dusty day is an application of becoming dust-coloured or dusty.
The Quranic active-participle sense covers remaining or being left behind.
Pointer-only cross-reference to another lexical entry.

cautions: The root has a documented opposition between meanings of remaining and passing away; the Quranic form غَابِرِينَ is supported here specifically in the remaining or being-left-behind sense.
Lane's discussion of تَغْبِيرٌ and مُغَبِّرَةٌ refers to Quranic recitation as part of a devotional practice but does not supply a securely usable modern Quran verse location.
